summary: Read Ethereum mainnet height and finalized native ETH balance with a chain-ID check and exact decimal strings.
features: Check provider-reported Ethereum chain ID before latest block-height or balance read
Read finalized native wei/ETH for one provided public hex address without floats
requirements: Node24 on MCP host and HTTPS access to fixed PublicNode Ethereum RPC
Observe PublicNode terms/privacy/quotas and independently check address/provider before financial decisions
limits: Ethereum mainnet only, no other EVM networks, wallets, keys, signing, transfers, contracts, tokens/NFTs or address discovery
Address hex/length only; EIP-55 checksum, ownership, spendability and independent chain consensus not verified
One call at a time plus 1 second after completion, no automatic retries, polling, paging or fallback
Strict uint256 canonical hex and JSON-RPC envelope; unsupported data fails rather than round or invent zero
pricing: Anonymous PublicNode endpoint; no paid account, archive access, credit or transaction fee initiated by these reads. Terms, quotas, restrictions and availability apply; no production SLA.
privacy: PublicNode sees requested address when supplied, methods/network/IP; public addresses may identify people. Queries/results may remain in APX chat. Package reads no wallet/profile/credential store and writes no result cache; provider privacy marketing is not a guarantee.
tagline: Read Ethereum height and exact native ETH balances
description:
Read the provider-reported Ethereum mainnet block height or the finalized native ETH balance of a public address you supply. The connection checks the reported chain identifier and returns exact decimal wei and ETH values rather than rounded amounts.

This is Ethereum mainnet reading only, not a wallet or a connection to every EVM network. It cannot sign, transfer, trade, read token balances or discover addresses. PublicNode receives the requests, and separate reads are not one snapshot. No automatic polling or retries are included. A reported balance does not establish ownership, spendability or financial safety.
prompts: Read the provider-reported Ethereum mainnet block height with its chain check.
Read the finalized native ETH balance for the public address I provide, preserving exact wei and ETH values.
Explain the difference between the returned native balance and token holdings without making another query.

es.tagline: Leé altura de Ethereum y saldos nativos exactos
es.description:
Leé la altura de bloque informada por el proveedor para Ethereum mainnet o el saldo nativo finalizado de una dirección pública que indiques. La conexión comprueba el identificador de red informado y devuelve valores decimales exactos en wei y ETH, sin redondear importes.

Es sólo lectura de Ethereum mainnet, no una billetera ni una conexión a todas las redes EVM. No firma, transfiere, opera, lee saldos de tokens ni descubre direcciones. PublicNode recibe las consultas y las lecturas separadas no forman una única instantánea. No incluye consultas periódicas ni reintentos automáticos. Un saldo informado no prueba propiedad, disponibilidad de fondos ni seguridad financiera.
prompts: Leé la altura de bloque de Ethereum mainnet informada por el proveedor con su comprobación de red.
Leé el saldo nativo finalizado de la dirección pública que te pase, conservando los valores exactos en wei y ETH.
Explicame la diferencia entre el saldo nativo devuelto y las tenencias de tokens sin hacer otra consulta.
